title: British Pound consolidates above 1.3500 vs USD ahead of this week's UK data, Fed, BoE
summary: The GBP/USD pair struggles to capitalize on Friday's bounce from the vicinity of the monthly swing low and consolidates above the 1.3500 psychological mark at the start of a new week.

title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7698 vs. 6.7743 previous
summary: On Monday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7698 compared to Friday's fix of 6.7743 and 6.7083 Reuters estimate.
